nodes.description: IERC20 token contract reference used for balanceOf/transferFrom/transfer.
Constant cap of 4_000_000 ether tokens available in the presale.
Tracks how many presale tokens have already been issued.
Treasury address receiving ETH and supplying presale tokens.
Constant USDC address used as price-feed quote asset.
Constant Uniswap router address used for price discovery.
Constant WETH address used as price-feed base asset.
Presale start timestamp; presale window is startDate..startDate+2 days.
Last quarter index for which vested tokens were already withdrawn.
Constant 187_500 ether released per vesting quarter.
Simple reentrancy guard flag toggled around the receive() disbursement.
Constant initial ETH price guess of 1400 dollars.
Updatable ETH price in dollars used to compute token amounts.
Constant rate of 4 tokens per dollar.
Constant maximum token balance allowed per wallet.
Initializes MFI, treasury and startDate state variables.
Payable fallback that sells tokens for ETH, issues refunds and forwards ETH to treasury.
Permissionless price update via Uniswap getAmountsOut(WETH,USDC).
Internal pure helper returning the smallest of three values.
Internal pure helper performing checked subtraction with require.
Permissionless quarterly vesting release of tokens to treasury.
Caller-controlled address receiving tokens/refunds and passing balance checks.
Miner/validator-influenced timestamp gating presale window and vesting quarters.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(ethReturn) external ETH refund to untrusted caller.
payable(treasury).transfer(msg.value - ethReturn) external ETH forward.
MFI.transferFrom(treasury, msg.sender, tokensToTransfer) external token call.
MFI.transfer(treasury, vestingQuarterly) external token call in withdrawVested.
UniRouter.getAmountsOut external call providing the ETH/USD price.
Arithmetic dollarsPerETH * tokensPerDollar computing tokensPerETH.
Arithmetic msg.value * tokensPerETH computing tokensRequested.
Arithmetic subtraction a - b in sub() with underflow require guard.
Constructor parameter for the IERC20 presale token.
Constructor parameter for the presale start date.
Constructor parameter for the treasury address.
First candidate value of min().
Second candidate value of min().
Third candidate value of min().
Minuend of sub().
Subtrahend of sub().
Computed presale end date = startDate + 2 days.
Local token-per-ETH rate derived from dollarsPerETH.
Requested token amount = msg.value * tokensPerETH.
Actual tokens transferred after supply and wallet caps.
ETH refunded to buyer when capped.
Swap path [WETH, USDC] for the router price query.
Elapsed time since startDate in withdrawVested.
Current vesting quarter index.

tokensPerDollar used in the rate multiplication

receive() forwards the remaining ETH to treasury
receive() pulls tokens to the buyer via transferFrom

receive() multiplies msg.value by tokensPerETH
receive() calls sub() for supply/wallet/refund arithmetic
receive() calls min() to cap the token amount

withdrawVested transfers vested tokens out

external ETH transfer to msg.sender can re-enter receive()
external token transferFrom call can re-enter receive()
tokenContract parameter stored into MFI
_startDate parameter stored into startDate

first min() candidate flows into result
second min() candidate flows into result

subtrahend flows into sub()

constructor assigns treasury state variable
